name: Water Elemental Bracers
summary: Water Elemental Bracers are magical remains taken from lesser water elementals on the Haunted Isle. Baron Revilgaz wants specimens examined for a way to counter the Stone of the Tides’ curse.

sections.title: Island Specimens
sections.body: The Haunted Isle in northern Stranglethorn is home to lesser water elementals, whose bracers hold magical residue. Baron Revilgaz asks you to bring him six specimens from the island. He hopes a mage in Dalaran can study them and find a way to counter the Stone of the Tides’ curse.

faq.q: Where do Water Elemental Bracers come from?
faq.answer: Lesser water elementals on the Haunted Isle in northern Stranglethorn carry Water Elemental Bracers.
Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay wants six Water Elemental Bracers so a mage in Dalaran can examine their magical residue.

faq.q: Why does Revilgaz want the bracers?
faq.answer: Revilgaz hopes a mage in Dalaran can study the bracers’ magical residue and find a way to counter the Stone of the Tides’ curse.

faq.q: What is the Stone of the Tides?
faq.answer: The Stone of the Tides is said to curse its bearer, causing them to fade in and out of existence.

faq.q: How many bracers does Revilgaz need?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz asks for six Water Elemental Bracers.

angles.text: As a mage, you may be asked to study the magical residue on these bracers for a way to counter the Stone of the Tides’ curse.
